elaine: Quick capacity check — demo next Thurs (Apr 7) needs ~8 H100s in us-west1 for a 4h window (13:00-17:00 PT). Can vendor hold slots and do we have spare GPU quota? CC @vendor-liaison
ryan: pinged vendor last night, they said tentative but need confirmation by Tue. I'll follow up and forward the ticket.
vendor-liaison: Vendor update: we can hold 8x H100 in us-west1 for 2026-04-07 13:00-17:00 PT. Need PO or billing profile by Tue EOD to lock. Ticket: https://vendor.example/RC-12345
dmitri: quick quota check — looks like project GPU quota is exhausted in us-west1. Run to verify:```bash
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-infra | grep -A2 quotas
```I can file a cloud quota request now (it usually takes 24-48h).
sophia: If quota slow, fallback plan: mix 4 H100 + 8 A100 across two racks. Expect ~10-20% perf variance depending on model; cost +~12%. Happy to produce perf matrix.
elaine: OK — actionable: (1) ryan, confirm with vendor and ask them to hold til Tue EOD, (2) dmitri file quota ticket, (3) sophia prepare mixed-pool config and perf/cost estimate. Finance will need PO if vendor requires it — I’ll loop them in.
ryan: filing vendor confirmation now, adding finance contact. PR with proposed reservation config: https://git.company/infra/reservations/pull/789 — includes tags for billing profile. :thumbsup:
oncall: note — if we go A100 fallback, spot eviction risk that day is medium-high based on recent trends. Prefer dedicated reservations for the demo window. Also double-check rack power headroom with vendor before committing.
deploy-bot: Reservation draft created: id=draft-2026-04-07-elaine (automated) — https://infra.company/reservations/draft-2026-04-07-elaine
sophia: I'll put the mixed-pool perf numbers in #eng-sre later today and attach a quick script to shuffle traffic if we need to degrade gracefully.
elaine: thanks all — please update ticket links in this thread as they come in so I can hand off to ops and finance tomorrow morning.
